pointConvention: Approximate visible front-face crown corners in source pixels; 8 px picking uncertainty. The left-return foot is partly occluded and has 20 px uncertainty.
method: Local weak-perspective reconstruction. Estimate orthogonal horizontal axes from crown directions, use existing rear width as similarity datum, derive heights from the visible left-return foot. Do not fit an arbitrary percentage or assume screen y equals world height.
limits: Crown picks have 8 px uncertainty; partly occluded left-return foot has 20 px uncertainty. Minor frontage notch at the low-wall end is excluded from the long-run length. Preserve a single floor and horizontal tops; disclose residuals.
